name: 进门-券商点评助手
description_zh: 依赖进门 MCP 获取卖方点评数据，生成券商段子/点评日报，或按点评做多轮问答。支持全面版、大板块、行业、公司与闲聊模式。在用户提到券商点评、券商段子、卖方日报、晨会总结、科技/周期等板块梳理、按行业或公司总结点评、点评问答时使用。
description_en: Requires the Comein MCP to retrieve sell-side commentary, then generates broker commentary digests or daily commentary reports and supports multi-turn question answering based on the commentary. It provides full-market, major-sector, industry, company, and chat modes. Use it for requests involving broker commentary, broker digests, sell-side daily reports, morning-meeting summaries, technology or cyclical sector reviews, industry or company commentary summaries, and commentary-based question answering.
